jobs.jobDescription: Looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure to lead frontend architecture and scale core services.
Seeking a creative UI/UX designer to collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft intuitive web and mobile interfaces. Figma proficiency required.
6-month contract opportunity to design CI/CD pipelines, automate Kubernetes clusters, and optimize AWS infrastructure security.
Analyze complex financial datasets using SQL and Python to build interactive executive dashboards and support strategic decision-making.
Manage SEO, SEM, and multi-channel paid social campaigns to drive organic traffic and optimize conversion funnels for client projects.
Execute vulnerability assessments and SOC 2 compliance audits for enterprise clients on a 3-month contract basis.
Own post-onboarding relationships for enterprise clients, driving product adoption, retention, and account expansion.
